<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class Root
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $a,
        public readonly B $b,
    ) {
    }

    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            a: $data['a'],
            b: B::fromArray($data['b']),
        );
    }
}

final class B
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly mixed $c,
    ) {
    }

    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            c: $data['c'],
        );
    }
}
